Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Yes, you can cancel an order after placing it, but it depends on what kind of order it was, and there isn’t a single “time window” rule for all orders. 
If it was a gift offer delivery: only pending deliveries can be canceled (or rescheduled). Once the gift has been delivered, it can’t be modified. 
If it was a subscription or payment plan: you can cancel future payments from the transaction, and you can choose when it ends (end of current billing period, a custom date, or cancel now).  
If it was a one-time payment (no future payments): you can’t cancel payments, but you can revoke access to the product.
